Maintain identical garden picnic table geography and actor positions (Mother in dusty-teal top seated at bench right, Alice in rose-pink heart PJs kneeling on cushion left, sealed bottle held by Mother at entry). Premium cinematic stylized 3D preschool animation with detailed soft hair and fabric, rounded appealing forms, gentle natural daylight, coherent contacts and stable animal anatomy. There are exactly THREE human characters in the scene world: Mother, toddler Alice, and one adult Dutch milkmaid. Mother and Alice are the only dialogue speakers; the milkmaid is a silent working background adult. Exactly two dairy cows remain beyond the fence. No extra farmers, children or people. Do not merge the milkmaid with Mother, do not duplicate Alice, and do not change any character's age. No native captions, letters, labels or logos; educational typography is added in Remotion. No photographic humans, anime or flat vector restyling. Every shot stays outdoors in the same garden and farm; no kitchen, bedroom, glass conservatory, enclosed room or window framing.
Alice is a human stylized 3D toddler girl about two years old, petite short torso and soft short limbs, oversized round head, full rosy cheeks, warm peach skin, very large dark-brown eyes with near-black pupils and white catchlights, fine dark brows, delicate lashes, tiny round button nose, small pink lips and baby teeth, small rounded ears and chin. Her dark black-brown straight chin-length bob has straight forehead bangs and small tied side sections. Exactly one pink bow stays on her anatomical RIGHT, viewer LEFT in frontal views; never mirror it. She wears rose-pink long-sleeve two-piece pajamas with exactly one centered white heart on the FRONT chest, matching rose-pink loose trousers with ribbed cuffs and pale-pink socks. No added shoes, hat, glasses, jewelry, markings or logos. Preserve her approved face geometry, eyes, cheeks, age, hair and proportions; expressions and speech phonemes may change only for acting.
Mom-Alice is a human stylized 3D adult woman about thirty years old, about twice Alice's standing height, slender natural adult proportions, softly rounded oval face, warm light-peach skin with subtle freckles, warm brown eyes with near-black pupils and white catchlights, softly arched chestnut eyebrows, delicate lashes, small rounded nose, natural pink lips, rounded ears and chin. Her chestnut shoulder-length hair has soft waves, a side part and gently swept front hair. She wears a plain dusty-teal short-sleeve crewneck top, cream straight tailored trousers and off-white low flat shoes. No bow, hat, glasses, jewelry or extra accessories. Preserve the canonical face geometry, eye spacing, nose, lips, skin, freckles, age and hairstyle; only expression, gaze, blinking and speech phonemes may change for acting.
The Dutch milkmaid is a DISTINCT ADULT human dairy worker about thirty-five years old, visibly adult in face and full-height natural proportions, with fair lightly freckled skin, blue-gray eyes, a relaxed oval face, a practical long blonde braid and a small plain white cotton work cap. She wears a modest sky-blue work dress over a white long-sleeve cotton blouse, a plain white full apron and dark practical farm boots. No logos, brand marks, text or jewelry. Her face, blonde hair, dress and adult proportions must remain separate from Mother and Alice. She works calmly seated on a low stable milking stool beside Cow A at the farm-side station. Her lips stay gently touching at all times; she never speaks, sings, mouths the family dialogue or smiles with an open mouth. Preserve her identity across the episode after a new local canonical reference is created and reviewed.

Attach approved Dutch milkmaid reference production-local/ComfyUI/output/04-milk-and-mom/characters/milkmaid/fullbody-v001-flux-candidate_00001_.png SHA256 4adaee1fdb9ee808efeeb802a1eb2fecc9520450c518ec797604afa8d31d1150 (distinct adult dairy worker ~35yo, blonde braid, white cap, sky-blue dress over white blouse, white apron, dark farm boots; silent with lips closed at all times).
An entirely OUTDOOR cottage garden beside a dairy pasture in soft warm morning daylight. A low oval wooden picnic table stands on a dry woven garden mat with two floor cushions; a shaded wooden garden bench sits beneath a leafy tree. Flower borders, green grass and a small distant red barn establish the farm. A continuous sturdy wooden fence separates the garden from the pasture and the sheltered farm-side milking station. Mother and Alice always remain on the garden side, several steps from the fence; they never reach through or enter the cow enclosure. Exactly TWO calm adult black-and-white dairy cows inhabit the farm: Cow A, with a broad black shoulder patch and white forehead, stands quietly side-on at the sheltered station; Cow B, with a black patch around its right eye, grazes farther back in the pasture. Keep their markings, adult scale and count consistent. At least one cow remains clearly visible in every shot. The adult Dutch milkmaid sits beside Cow A under the open-sided timber shelter, hand-milking gently into one stable metal pail beneath the udder. Her two hands use a plausible alternating squeeze-and-release action; brief thin milk streams enter the pail. The cows never speak or enter the garden. The milking pail and its fresh raw contents remain entirely on the farm side. The family's sealed ready-to-drink milk bottle came separately from the picnic basket and stays on the garden table; never show cow milk transferred straight to Alice, her cup or that sealed bottle.
Outdoor child-eye medium-close two-shot from the same garden axis, with Cow B visibly grazing beyond the fence and the shelter remaining in the established background direction. Mother begins holding the bottle exactly as the incoming image, then gently sets its base on the tray. Alice points to the milk and speaks, with no bottle handoff. A very gentle child-eye push-in emphasizes her expression without cutting or crossing the axis. Mother stays silent with closed lips. The milkmaid continues quietly at the station if visible. No drinking, cup handoff or connection between the lesson bottle and the milking pail.
Only alice speaks this shot. Exact English line: Milk is white, smooth, and liquid, Mommy! Silent characters: mother, milkmaid. Synchronize only the speaker mouth to the accepted final VoiceStudio WAV. The silent family listener and the milkmaid keep lips gently touching, with no extra words, singing or mimicking. No animal speech. Use modest natural cow movement; any visible milkmaid remains quiet in the established farm-side background. No old03 frame, footage or motion segment may be inserted. Keep raw milk on the farm side and the sealed lesson bottle separate. Current-shot human framing: two foreground humans; the one milkmaid may be distant, partly occluded or outside the close crop, but no extra human may appear.
